lifecycle.title: poster-php Lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: One captcha round-trip and one poster build: from creation to expiry / from init to output

lanes.title: ① Captcha Lifecycle
steps: create(type) — click / rotate / slider / random, difficulty optional
generate() — random key + background + targets (coords / angle / gap)
set(key, data, ttl) — File / Session / Redis, 300s and one-shot
output('png') → base64 image + extra hints, never the answer
inside tolerance → pass; outside → fail; no key → expired
branches: del(key) — the same key can never be reused
attempts+1, up to 3 retries, then invalidated
past TTL or unknown key — generate a new one

lanes.title: ② Poster Lifecycle
steps: drivers paint the canvas; origin is top-left, sizes scale
save(path, quality) to disk or output('png'|'jpg') as data URL
branches: save() writes to disk for CDN / object storage
output() returns base64, ready for the frontend
same template, new variables — batch output
